# RO Engine

> RO Engine is shop management software for independent auto repair shops, built by a working shop owner. Its tagline is "The estimate that explains itself": the AI writes the maintenance recommendations on every repair order, and the customer's estimate explains each service in plain language — what it is, why it's due now, and what happens if they wait — written for the customer's own vehicle and sent to their phone. Customer education is the hardest part of selling maintenance; RO Engine does it on every car. One plan: $199/month launch price (regular $349), everything included, unlimited users, month to month. Each shop gets its own live copy of the app at its own address (yourshop.roengine.com), set up in minutes, free for 90 days.

## What it does
- **AI service recommendations on every repair order** — cross-checks the manufacturer maintenance schedule (82,000+ OEM service intervals), the vehicle's own history and known failure patterns; surfaces overdue and coming-due work, remembers deferred work from past visits, and explains it in plain language. Advisors choose normal or severe service schedules.
- **AI phone answering** — answers when the counter is busy, takes vehicle and customer details, and puts the call transcript on the customer record. Included, not an add-on.
- **One inbox:** texts, email and calls (with recordings and transcripts) in one thread per customer, linked to the RO. Two-way texting with a local shop number and click-to-call.
- **Digital estimate approval** — customers approve or decline line by line from a private link (no app, no login), with an AI-written explanation of each service ("What is it?", "Why now?", "What happens if you wait?") and a diagram of the car showing where each service is; declines are saved as deferred work for the next visit.
- **Full comparison** with Tekmetric, Shop-Ware, Shopmonkey, AutoLeap and Mitchell 1 SE: https://roengine.com/compare/ — plan-by-plan pricing, plus "What we found only in RO Engine": 46 capabilities not found in the others' public release notes (May 2025–Oct 2026), corrections invited (https://roengine.com/compare/#only)
- **Parts and purchase orders** — parts searched and ordered from the repair order on the shop's own supplier accounts (RO Engine never stores supplier passwords), purchase orders and receiving, core charges and returns, margin visible before approval.
- **Photo intake** — VIN from the door jamb sticker, mileage from the dashboard, plate capture, timestamped condition photos.
- **Multi-point inspections** — green/yellow/red ratings with photos; tech notes rewritten for customers; red findings become recommendations.
- **Oil-change decals** — the shop designs its own windshield decal in Settings (logo, text, layout, drag and drop, with a print preview); next-due miles and date fill in from the shop's oil-change presets, and it prints on a thermal label printer when the oil change is marked complete.
- Work orders, invoicing, customers, vehicles, scheduling and reports.

## Pricing
- One plan, every feature on from day one: $199 per month launch price, locked in for as long as the shop stays (regular price $349 per month). No tiers, no add-ons, no per-user fees, no contract; cancel any month.
- Includes 300 AI phone minutes, 300 calls on the shop line and 1,500 texts a month. Beyond that: $0.35 per minute, $0.10 per call, $0.02 per text.
- RO Engine does not take a cut of a shop's card processing; its revenue is the subscription.
- Easy out: the owner can export all the shop's data at any time from Settings → Export Data — customers, vehicles, repair orders and invoices, payments, inspections, estimates, appointments, messages, inventory, vendors and purchase orders as CSV and/or JSON (with a README explaining how the files link), plus every photo filed by repair order. No fee and no request needed; export is not tied to billing, so a cancelled shop can still sign in and take its data.
- QuickBooks Online sync (Intuit-approved; details at https://roengine.com/quickbooks/): either an invoice and payment per repair order, or one journal entry per day for shops whose accountant wants QuickBooks lean; a CSV of the same accounting ledger covers other bookkeeping.

## The free trial
- Not a demo or sandbox: signing up creates the shop's own live RO Engine at yourshop.roengine.com, ready in minutes.
- 90 days free; no card needed to start (a card or bank account can be added any time before the trial ends); cancel online.
- Everything entered during the trial carries forward when the shop stays.
- Texting and the AI phone switch on once the shop's number clears carrier registration (usually within two weeks); everything else works immediately.
- Customer, vehicle and repair history migration is free; migration from Shop-Ware is already proven (full repair orders, inspections, photos, payments): https://roengine.com/shop-ware/

## Who built it
RO Engine is built by Joe Sprandel, an independent shop owner with 13+ years on the shop floor who built his first custom shop system in 2013. Every feature runs in his own shop every day before it ships.

  - [Online booking](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lGv2GY12MSo): a website booking lands on the schedule as a repair order
  - [Ask the shop](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QFnPTjVbzeU): Mnemos, the AI assistant, answers from the shop's live data and stages changes as cards for a person to approve

  - [Scan the bottle](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lr_bWFcKRcQ): the AI reads a fluid bottle's specs and OEM approvals into inventory
  - [Leave whenever, with everything](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KS_asJ9icJo): Settings → Export Data — every table as CSV + JSON with a README, and every photo in a folder per repair order
